principle: Final zero-shot evaluation data must not be used for model fitting, feature selection, threshold selection, normalization, calibration, or post-hoc redesign.

libero_spatial.reason: Multiple tasks and seeds have been used for training, calibration, diagnostics, and architecture decisions.

libero_object.reason: Task 0 and cross-suite results have been inspected; an earlier manifest also assigned tasks to development/calibration.

libero_goal.reason: Task 2 and cross-suite results have been inspected; an earlier manifest also assigned tasks to development/calibration.

libero_90.reason: Tasks were already selected in a development plan. It may be used only under a separately frozen task holdout declared before access.

libero_10.reason: First opened only after the v3 relational model, DROID source thresholds, task list, seeds, metrics, and code hashes were frozen. The completed 40-episode result is immutable; this suite is now diagnostic-only and cannot serve as a new final holdout.
required_before_use: freeze model weights, feature code, thresholds, and metrics
do not inspect per-task outputs until the complete registered run finishes

external_training_policy.selection_basis: physics and sensor coverage, not similarity to particular LIBERO test scenes

reported_tracks.zero_shot: External data only; no target-domain fitting or calibration.
reported_tracks.normal_only_adaptation: A separately reported deployment track using a predeclared amount of unlabeled target-domain normal data.
reported_tracks.in_domain: Development evidence only, never presented as broad generalization.
